style.prompt: Photorealistic marketplace catalog product photograph of exactly one white leather sneaker, square composition, isolated on a seamless pure white background (#FFFFFF). Only the single shoe is visible: no person, feet, hands, other shoes, props, text, logo, watermark, packaging, or decorative elements. Clean low-top white leather sneaker with white laces and white rubber sole, realistic fine leather texture and precise stitching, three-quarter side view showing the toe and outer side, entire shoe fully inside the frame, centered with generous even white margins. Soft neutral studio lighting, accurate white balance, crisp focus, subtle natural contact shadow directly beneath the sole, premium e-commerce photography.
